note: Example data: an invented online booking software company with invented accounts, not a real business. Every number in expected_output.json follows from this input. Post texts, hashtags and accounts are invented too.
request: Hey Claude, I just added the "social-content" skill. Look at what worked on our social accounts and plan and write our next two weeks of posts. We can make about 4 new pieces a week, and please adapt one caption for the UK and for French-speaking Canada.

answers.audience: not given, so inferred from the top posts
answers.voice: not given, so the voice of the top-scored posts

business: Example Booking Software, an online booking and scheduling app for small service businesses (invented example)
window: posts from 2025-10-28 to 2026-10-21: the last 365 days, leaving out the 7 days before the run
data_pulled: facebook-pages get_page_info, get_posts (121 posts in the last 365 days), get_post_insights for the 50 most recent content posts at least 7 days old
instagram-profile get_profile, get_media paged with after (112 posts), get_media_insights for the 50 most recent content posts at least 7 days old
tiktok-pages get_user_info, list_videos with auto_paginate (108 videos; views, likes, comments and shares come in the same reply)
linkedin-pages, threads and x-organic: query_contexts accounts returned no account for this business
